\section[(dialogue)]{The body, people and food — a first pass}

\label{lesson:GE-R79-first-pass-the-body-people-and-food}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a fork and a knife.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a leg, a tooth, the neck; the throat, a shoulder, a knee
  \item the face, blood, skin, a hair; hair, the belly
  \item the back, the tongue, a lip, a toe, the stomach
  \item a fever, a doctor, a doctor, a hospital, ill
  \item healthy, thirst, hunger, sad, happy
  \item fear, joy, a son, a daughter, a grandfather
  \item a grandmother, a woman; a wife, a girl, an uncle, an aunt
  \item a neighbour, a guest, a grandson, a pupil, a pupil
  \item to buy, to play, to know, to find, to look for
  \item to wait, to pay, to cook, to laugh, to cry
  \item to sing, to travel, to show, to bring, to forget
  \item to lose, to believe, to need, to live, to call
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A leg? (\textbf{das Bein}.) A tooth? (\textbf{der Zahn}.) The neck; the throat? (\textbf{der Hals}.) A shoulder? (\textbf{die Schulter}.) A knee? (\textbf{das Knie}.) The face? (\textbf{das Gesicht}.) Blood? (\textbf{das Blut}.) Skin? (\textbf{die Haut}.) A hair; hair? (\textbf{das Haar}.) The belly? (\textbf{der Bauch}.) The back? (\textbf{der Rücken}.) The tongue? (\textbf{die Zunge}.) A lip? (\textbf{die Lippe}.) A toe? (\textbf{die Zehe}.) The stomach? (\textbf{der Magen}.) A fever? (\textbf{das Fieber}.) A doctor? (\textbf{der Arzt}.) A doctor? (\textbf{die Ärztin}.) A hospital? (\textbf{das Krankenhaus}.) Ill? (\textbf{krank}.) Healthy? (\textbf{gesund}.) Thirst? (\textbf{der Durst}.) Hunger? (\textbf{der Hunger}.) Sad? (\textbf{traurig}.) Happy? (\textbf{glücklich}.) Fear? (\textbf{die Angst}.) Joy? (\textbf{die Freude}.) A son? (\textbf{der Sohn}.) A daughter? (\textbf{die Tochter}.) A grandfather? (\textbf{der Großvater}.) A grandmother? (\textbf{die Großmutter}.) A woman; a wife? (\textbf{die Frau}.) A girl? (\textbf{das Mädchen}.) An uncle? (\textbf{der Onkel}.) An aunt? (\textbf{die Tante}.) A neighbour? (\textbf{der Nachbar}.) A guest? (\textbf{der Gast}.) A grandson? (\textbf{der Enkel}.) A pupil? (\textbf{der Schüler}.) A pupil? (\textbf{die Schülerin}.) To buy? (\textbf{kaufen}.) To play? (\textbf{spielen}.) To know? (\textbf{wissen}.) To find? (\textbf{finden}.) To look for? (\textbf{suchen}.) To wait? (\textbf{warten}.) To pay? (\textbf{bezahlen}.) To cook? (\textbf{kochen}.) To laugh? (\textbf{lachen}.) To cry? (\textbf{weinen}.) To sing? (\textbf{singen}.) To travel? (\textbf{reisen}.) To show? (\textbf{zeigen}.) To bring? (\textbf{bringen}.) To forget? (\textbf{vergessen}.) To lose? (\textbf{verlieren}.) To believe? (\textbf{glauben}.) To need? (\textbf{brauchen}.) To live? (\textbf{leben}.) To call? (\textbf{rufen}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{The house, school things and nature — a second pass}

\label{lesson:GE-R79-second-pass-the-house-school-things-and-nature}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to carry; to wear and to send.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to carry; to wear, to send, to count, to paint, to clean
  \item a fish, meat, a chicken, fruit, an apple
  \item a banana, a potato, a tomato, an onion, a carrot
  \item a cake, a soup, honey, oil, lunch
  \item dinner, breakfast, rice, a pear, a lemon
  \item a grape, jam, cheese, salt, sugar
  \item juice, a sausage, ham, a salad; lettuce, noodles
  \item cream, pepper, a nut, beer, to cut
  \item a window, a chair, a table, a wall, a roof
  \item a garden, a lamp, a bath; a bathroom, a room, a bed
  \item a cupboard, the floor; the ground, the stairs, a mirror, a flat
  \item a cup, a plate, a glass, a fork, a knife
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To carry; to wear? (\textbf{tragen}.) To send? (\textbf{schicken}.) To count? (\textbf{zählen}.) To paint? (\textbf{malen}.) To clean? (\textbf{putzen}.) A fish? (\textbf{der Fisch}.) Meat? (\textbf{das Fleisch}.) A chicken? (\textbf{das Huhn}.) Fruit? (\textbf{das Obst}.) An apple? (\textbf{der Apfel}.) A banana? (\textbf{die Banane}.) A potato? (\textbf{die Kartoffel}.) A tomato? (\textbf{die Tomate}.) An onion? (\textbf{die Zwiebel}.) A carrot? (\textbf{die Möhre}.) A cake? (\textbf{der Kuchen}.) A soup? (\textbf{die Suppe}.) Honey? (\textbf{der Honig}.) Oil? (\textbf{das Öl}.) Lunch? (\textbf{das Mittagessen}.) Dinner? (\textbf{das Abendessen}.) Breakfast? (\textbf{das Frühstück}.) Rice? (\textbf{der Reis}.) A pear? (\textbf{die Birne}.) A lemon? (\textbf{die Zitrone}.) A grape? (\textbf{die Traube}.) Jam? (\textbf{die Marmelade}.) Cheese? (\textbf{der Käse}.) Salt? (\textbf{das Salz}.) Sugar? (\textbf{der Zucker}.) Juice? (\textbf{der Saft}.) A sausage? (\textbf{die Wurst}.) Ham? (\textbf{der Schinken}.) A salad; lettuce? (\textbf{der Salat}.) Noodles? (\textbf{die Nudeln}.) Cream? (\textbf{die Sahne}.) Pepper? (\textbf{der Pfeffer}.) A nut? (\textbf{die Nuss}.) Beer? (\textbf{das Bier}.) To cut? (\textbf{schneiden}.) A window? (\textbf{das Fenster}.) A chair? (\textbf{der Stuhl}.) A table? (\textbf{der Tisch}.) A wall? (\textbf{die Wand}.) A roof? (\textbf{das Dach}.) A garden? (\textbf{der Garten}.) A lamp? (\textbf{die Lampe}.) A bath; a bathroom? (\textbf{das Bad}.) A room? (\textbf{das Zimmer}.) A bed? (\textbf{das Bett}.) A cupboard? (\textbf{der Schrank}.) The floor; the ground? (\textbf{der Boden}.) The stairs? (\textbf{die Treppe}.) A mirror? (\textbf{der Spiegel}.) A flat? (\textbf{die Wohnung}.) A cup? (\textbf{die Tasse}.) A plate? (\textbf{der Teller}.) A glass? (\textbf{das Glas}.) A fork? (\textbf{die Gabel}.) A knife? (\textbf{das Messer}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
